reviewMethod: Manual independent CROSS semantic judgment of all 40 frozen expected/criticalExpected conditions against the complete recorded actual history and current generated response. Blind to every other review and historical outputs/metrics; no reserved evaluation or TEST was read. Independence is from the primary AI review, not an independent human panel. Boolean native dimensions are preserved; 0/.5/1 semanticScore is supplementary (all 40 = 0). Critical failures require an intelligible affirmative assertion violating the explicit criticalExpected; omitted answers and uninterpretable fragments are failed without fabricating critical assertions. No model inference, training or software tests. Native assessor executed unchanged through stdlib AST extraction on one allowed CPU.
limits: Autoría y revisión de IA del proyecto, no panel humano independiente.
Diez diálogos cotidianos y cuarenta turnos; cobertura limitada, sin garantía de generalización fuera de esta prueba.
No acredita habilidades autónomas, herramientas ejecutadas, memoria persistente, entrenamiento provocado por una charla ni trabajo real fuera de la conversación.
No contiene datos personales del creador; las situaciones son originales y ficticias.
